english.title: Proprietor of hackney carriage / PHV fail to produce licence to authorised officer for inspection - outside London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of

(A)_[a hackney carriage]_
(B)_[a private hire vehicle]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), licensed by **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT COUNCIL..), failed without reasonable excuse to produce for inspection the vehicle licence for the vehicle at the request of an authorised officer of the council
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 50(4) and (5) and 76 Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
